notes: Phase 6 Part 2 regression corpus. Expected attack-path statuses follow docs/attack-graph.md: CONFIRMED | LIKELY | UNVERIFIED | INVALID | BLOCKED. Cases marked "soft": true exercise patterns (confused deputy, state-dependent / cross-request chains) that no shipped chaining detector recognizes yet — tests/test_attack_graph_corpus.py skips (never fails) those cases when no path is produced, so this suite stays green while other in-flight work lands the matching detector. All other cases exercise chaining.py capabilities that already exist and are hard-asserted.

cases.notes: Stable always-on anchor: no control sits on the path.
require_admin fails closed (signature + expiry + role check). Only the unauthenticated-attacker path is BLOCKED.

cases.chain: reflected-xss (/profile) and path-traversal (/files/read) — same file, unrelated
cases.notes: Same-file co-location must not be upgraded into a chain.

cases.chain: scheduled task (unknown activation flag) -> command-injection -> filesystem
cases.notes: No code-visible way to resolve whether the remote feature flag is ever on. Must not default to always-on or never-on.

cases.chain: authenticated user -> mass-assignment role escalation -> admin billing directory
cases.notes: require_admin trusts the same mutable role field the user just set on themselves.

cases.chain: tenant-A identity -> broken object-level authz -> tenant-B statement/PII
cases.notes: require_workspace_member checks caller org membership but never re-checks the returned statement's org_id.

cases.chain: prompt injection (fetched document) -> MCP agent -> privileged mcp_read_file tool -> secrets file
cases.notes: No allowlist and no human-confirmation gate on the MCP tool call.

cases.chain: any authenticated caller -> confused-deputy delegation (service's own key) -> another customer's refund data
cases.notes: Forward-looking: no shipped detector recognizes own-credential delegation without per-object authority re-check yet. Skip softly until it lands.

cases.chain: request-1 (apply-coupon, stores unvalidated state) -> request-2 (checkout, trusts state) -> pricing impact
cases.notes: Forward-looking: needs session-state dataflow tracked across two distinct handlers, which no shipped detector performs yet. Skip softly until it lands.
